author: ValWood
body: The InterPro family appear to be specific for Gos1. Gos1 and orthologs  orthologs appear to cause a defect in ER - Golgi v-m-t,  but they operate downstream of this pathway. However, because  the ER SNAREs, etc., do not get recycled correctly, lots of mutants cause defects at the first step even though they are downstream/indirect. I'm hoping that when we do the GO-CAMs, we can clear up any indirect annotations. For now I'm reporting the InterPro and PAINT mappings.
